About

Tileyard North is bringing a brand-new Christmas market to Wakefield this festive season!


Taking over the Tileyard North courtyard this new seasonal attraction will be open Thursday to Sunday, offering festive shopping, food, drink and entertainment.


Browse more than 20 independent traders selling gifts, crafts and seasonal treats, tuck into delicious street food, and enjoy live music throughout the event. Visitors can also experience the cosy atmosphere of the Bavarian Winter Hall, try their hand at curling, and gather around for some festive marshmallow toasting.


Set beneath twinkling lights and filled with festive atmosphere, the Tileyard North Courtyard Christmas Market is set to become a welcome addition to Wakefield’s Christmas celebrations.


Market Opening Times


Thursday & Friday | 4pm – 10pm


Saturday | 12pm – 10pm


Sunday | 12pm – 7pm
